peer_items.text: The User Interface Designer will design the LCD screen function menu.
Unclear what functions we had to include yet.
Elderly users may not understand the remote well; a simpler remote is needed.
The User Interface Designer will prepare a list of the functions to be shown on the screen/menu.
The User Interface Designer will group the menu into a display group and a basic functions group.
The Project Manager will reorganize the project materials after this meeting.
The User Interface Designer will create maps of the data gathered for the project.
Teletext functionality will be skipped and not used in the project.
The target age range is sixteen to forty.
We should have two different groups of functions: simple for the general public and advanced for younger users.
The team proposed implementing two menus: a button-based menu for direct access and an LCD/TV options menu activated by software options.
